method: Natural race from grid, six karts, auto-gas and steering assistance; no injected rank, progress, event or player position.
reason: The detected notice was only the lap-one preannouncement. In lap two the player crossed s=105–261 on the inland lane (about -1.6 to -2.0), while kart 2 was on the sea-side wave line at s=121, lane 1.85. No actual wave event activated; this exposed the trigger lane gate.
